family_summary: Across the four site pairs, AI-built pages typically use a contained, modern flexbox/grid layout with stacked full-width sections, a roughly 1020–1140px container and a left-aligned or two-column hero. The originals are more varied: floats, sidebars, centered logos, full-bleed banners, and one very long page.

attributes.summary: All four AI-built pages use a fixed container of about 1020–1140px, whereas the originals range from about 1080–1160px and one has no container at all.
Both AI-built pages combine flexbox and grid, while the originals use floats with fixed widths on one site and mainly flexbox on the other.
Most AI-built pages (2 of 3) use a small left-aligned logo, whereas the originals use large logos, two of them centered.

AI-built heroes are mostly left-aligned text blocks, with a logo, an empty right half, or a photo beside them, while two of the three originals use full-bleed photo banners and the third uses a logo and title lockup.

AI-built pages are mostly stacked full-width sections (4 of 5 observations) with one centered column, while the originals mostly use a two-column layout with a sidebar (4 of 5) and one unstyled stack.
AI-built pages are split evenly between short (about 2200–3950px) and long (about 5100–5650px), while three originals are short and one is very long at about 29,000px.
AI-built navs sit inline in the header, while the originals place the nav in a separate row or split it around a centered logo, and the one observed wrap to a second row occurs in both versions.

AI-built pages truncate with an ellipsis in one case and wrap to two lines in the other, while the originals truncate with an ellipsis in both title cases and overlap without wrapping in the term case.
AI-built pages place section illustrations on the right side of the section, whereas the originals place them as a banner or at the top of a column.
The one AI-built about section is a dark two-column band, whereas the original shows only a flush-left headshot.
No AI-built value was recorded, whereas the original has a large empty dark area before the footer.
The AI-built page centers the greeting under the hero, whereas the original puts it in a top-left dark strip.
The AI-built podcast section is a two-column cover and text layout, whereas the original uses a damask background with a cropped photo.
The AI-built page uses a left-aligned half-width text column, and no original value was recorded.
The AI-built promo is a full-section two-column layout, whereas the original is a sidebar widget.
